capabilities: Generate source-cited research answers from Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Perplexica/Vane, or LM Studio
Enhance selected text in a note with AI and choose replace, insert-below, or preview
Apply directory templates to one file or batch-fill every file in a folder
Retrieve verified company facts via Exa and funding rounds via Fireround before generation
Write citations footers, resolve grounding redirects, and strip tracking parameters from links
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13 or later. Core Perplexity and Claude providers need paid API keys; Exa, Gemini, and Firecrawl have free tiers. Full template reference lives in docs/directory-templates.md rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate research content with verified, durable citations inside notes, or to fill hundreds of same-shaped notes from one template.

relations.evidence: Support for Perplexity, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini (with Google Search grounding), Perplexica / Vane (self-hosted), and LM Studio
Exa finds and verifies the source material, and the writing model writes from it
Fireround adds a company's rounds to the note, with the raw data under your funding heading
Perplexica / Vane is a free, open-source AI search engine that you run locally
Local LLM Support: Integration with LM Studio for local AI processing
so cite-wide's hex-substitution pass works on Gemini output too

requires.name: Google Gemini API key (free tier available)
Exa API key (free tier with signup credit)
Firecrawl key for Fireround funding data

summary: AI research plugin that writes source-cited answers into notes using Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, self-hosted Perplexica/Vane, or local LM Studio, with directory templates for batch generation.
